source.author: cic
source.text: cum igitur nosce te dicit, hoc dicit: nosce animum tuum.
source.text_original: cum igitur nosce te dicit, hoc dicit: nosce animum tuum.
source.text_english: When, therefore, he says know yourself, he means this: know your mind.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: te ipsum intellege! , uenerationi mihi semper fuit non uerbosa rusticitas, sed sancta simplicitas: qui in sermone imitari se dicit apostolos, prius imitetur in uita.
reuse.text_original: 'te ipsum intellege'! —, uenerationi mihi semper fuit non uerbosa rusticitas, sed sancta simplicitas: qui in sermone imitari se dicit apostolos, prius imitetur in uita.
reuse.text_english: Understand yourself! For me, not loquacious rusticity but holy simplicity has always been an object of reverence: let him who says he imitates the apostles in speech first imitate them in life.
